About this workflow
widgets_values:
# Earth Zoom Into My Clip

From space down to your place: the Earth, a dive through the clouds, a satellite view with the place name, a drone view, then your own clip plays untouched with its sound. A photo alone gives a zoom loop. 9:16.

FreeField preset `earth-zoom`. Runs on an 8 GB GPU. Open weights only.

## Fill in
- A short outdoor clip (2-10 s), or a photo of a place: the node **The first frame of your clip (or your photo), 720x1280**
- Place name (the title): typed in the FreeField app (`--caption` on the command line)

## Stages, left to right
- 1\. Your place (frame 0 of your clip, or your photo)
- FLUX.2 klein 4B (all three views)
- 2\. Drone view of your place
- 3\. Satellite view (the drone view outpainted from above)
- 4\. Earth from space

## Models
- `flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors`
- `qwen_3_4b_fp8_mixed.safetensors`
- `flux2-vae.safetensors`

## What happens
This graph makes the three stills. FreeField's `freefield/earth_zoom.py` then flies down through them with cloud cuts, adds your place name and a whoosh, and plays your own clip untouched after the dive.

## Run it
1. Pick your file in the input node above and press Run.

Or run the whole effect in FreeField: `python -m freefield run earth-zoom --clip walk.mp4`

License: Apache-2.0 weights (FLUX.2 klein 4B); clouds, title and whoosh are generated by FreeField; the clip is your own footage
